findings.reason: as written item 2 can close while item 3 is unsatisfiable, so a node reaches the end of the section with a settled row whose advisory still stands and no rule that such a row does not count as settled.
findings.text: a `batch-272` row may be recorded as "already settled by `sn-definitions-by-construction` §6 with the edit that settled it", but §6's dispositions (definitions §5 line 103) include "hold from the cut" and "a recorded reason it stands", neither of which clears the unit-pair advisory that the next item makes a named witness; the previous review constrained the *declined* branch of this item for exactly this reason and the *settled* branch, added in this change, carries the same hole

findings.reason: the wrong instrument leaves the node unable to predict which rows §6 settles, and only §5's wording check could route one of them, so a row may be recorded as settled on a disposition that is not a rename.
findings.text: the sentence "`sn-definitions-by-construction` §6 may settle some of these rows itself, since its dimension check can route a mismatched name to a rename" cites a mechanism §6 does not hold: §6 executes §2's wording, §3's unit spelling and §5's name/definition dispositions, while §3's dimension check already ran (`sn-definitions-by-construction#s3` is declared done) and its committed census (`docs/evidence/fragments/sn-definitions-by-construction/unit-spelling-census.json`) lists the unit-pair rows under `divergences` with `recorded_exception: false`, not under the 41-entry `dimension_mismatches` list

findings.reason: a worker binding the row to "the rate family" lands on the wrong family and would carry the rename into the wrong batch's population.
findings.text: `source_rate_due_to_beam_beam_fusion` is placed "in the rate family", but the census's `physical_base` families place it in `source_rate`, and a separate family named `rate` exists in the same census (125 divergent families), so the family name in this sentence resolves to a different family than the row belongs to

response_events.note: Item 2 now records a unit-pair row as settled or declined only when its advisory is cleared, and says a row held or let stand by definitions section 6 is still this section's.
